_about: Everything on the menu that is not a pizza. course: side, dessert or drink. make: oven = made on the bench and baked like a pizza (base, sauce, cheese, tops, spec in grams, as pizzas.json); cold = plated in mins minutes from the rail or the fridge; hand = a drink taken from the fridge with the order; bar = a drink made at the coffee machine or the bar in mins minutes. tier = the drinks upgrade it needs. tool = a utensil it needs (data/equipment.json). Customers order these on top of their pizzas; desserts at a table come after the meal.

items.name: Garlic bread
items.desc: A dough ball opened out, spread with a 1 oz ladle of garlic butter, baked and sliced.

items.name: Garlic bread with mozzarella
items.desc: Garlic bread with a layer of mozzarella.

items.name: Rocket and parmesan salad
items.desc: Plated cold from the rail: rocket, halved cherry tomatoes, parmesan, olive oil.

items.name: Chocolate hazelnut pizzetta
items.desc: A plain base baked, then spread with chocolate hazelnut on the board.

items.name: Tiramisu
items.desc: A portion from the tray in the fridge, plated and dusted.

items.name: Ice cream, two scoops
items.desc: Two scoops from the tub in the freezer. Needs an ice cream scoop.
